rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something continuing with no stated end.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 jat1 zik6 dang2 nei5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this especially when an arrangement, delay, or suspension has no deadline; it is less conversational than 一直.

example.english: This arrangement will be suspended indefinitely.
example.traditional: 呢項安排將無限期暫停。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 on1 paai4 zoeng1 mou4 haan6 kei4 zaam6 ting4
